verses.text: Finally, my brothers and sisters, be glad in the Lord! It is no trouble for me to write the same things to you again, and it keeps you safe.
Watch out for those dogs, those people who do evil. They insist on cutting the body.
It is we who are truly circumcised. We worship God by his Spirit. We boast in Christ Jesus, and put no trust in human things.
I could have reasons to trust in such things. If anyone else thinks he has reasons, I have more.
I was circumcised on the eighth day. I was born an Israelite, from the tribe of Benjamin, a true Hebrew. As for the law, I was a Pharisee.
As for being keen, I attacked the church. As for being right by keeping the law, no one could find fault with me.
But whatever was a gain to me, I now count as loss for the sake of Christ.
More than that, I count everything as loss compared with how great it is to know Christ Jesus my Lord. For him I have lost everything. I count it all as rubbish, so that I may gain Christ
and be found in him. I do not have my own rightness that comes from the law. I have the rightness that comes through faith in Christ. It comes from God and is received by faith.
I want to know Christ and the power of his rising from the dead. I want to share in his sufferings and become like him in his death.
Then somehow I too will rise from the dead.
I do not mean that I have already reached this, or that I am already perfect. But I keep pressing on to take hold of that for which Christ Jesus took hold of me.
Brothers and sisters, I do not think I have taken hold of it yet. But I do one thing. I forget what is behind me and reach out for what is ahead.
I press on towards the finish line, to win the prize. God has called me to it in Christ Jesus, to the life above.
All of us who are mature should think this way. If you think differently about something, God will make that clear to you too.
But let us live up to what we have already reached, following the same rule. Let us think the same way.
Brothers and sisters, join together in following my example. Pay attention to those who live as we showed you.
As I have often told you before, and now tell you again with tears, many people live as enemies of the cross of Christ.
Their end is ruin. Their stomach is their god. They are proud of things they should be ashamed of. Their minds are on earthly things.
But we are citizens of heaven. And we eagerly wait for a Saviour from there, the Lord Jesus Christ.
By the power that lets him rule over everything, he will change our weak bodies to be like his glorious body.
